Written with an explicit re-pinned-from clause to preserve that lineage by prose alone

obs-plan names four Tauri command spans that do not exist: start_scenario / stop_scenario / get_run_report / operator_pause_go_no_go (\u00a71 line 49, \u00a74 line 136, line 373) vs the shipped tauri.command.start_run / stop_run / run_report / resolve_operator_hold. cases.what: The plan required report.generate to carry verdict/state 'drawn from the typed values' but neither plan nor research said HOW to stringify them, and the obvious accessor is a trap: Verdict::label()/ReportState::label() are documented human labels that render CalibrationRegion as 'HOLD' and ManualCheck as 'Manual', which would have silently broken the a11y lamp-to-journal-row join the acceptance names. Settled by reading verdict.rs / report_state.rs and the db.rs value_as_wire precedent, then using the canonical Debug spelling, locked by a dedicated test. Also unstated: how to summarize N records for a run-scoped span -- resolved as distinct-first-seen rather than inventing a severity ranking the report seam does not own

The cp1252 encoding learning is directive-shaped ('always pass encoding=utf-8'), which the tier tree routes to Tier 1/2, but its scope is ad-hoc tooling rather than any project path -- no .claude/rules/* file covers it and creating one would have been forced. Demoted to Tier 3 via the Tier 2 fallback chain step 3, per 'better to over-route to Tier 3 than to invent weakly-scoped rule files'

plan.md step 1 enumerates 8 emission-shape variants with their per-family parameters (fingerprint variant mix, severity mix, p50/p95/p99, PII categories, error placement + fraction, rate curve), but research only captured the primitives' EXPORT names from conductor-emit/src/lib.rs:23-32 — no primitive's actual constructor or field surface was read, so those parameter lists rest on export names plus scenario-TOML prose and /implement must confirm each against the real signature.

A tension P2's check C surfaced only as a unilateral binding turned out to be substantive at synthesis: layouts requires the emission tally to be ONE number shared with the cli indicatif heartbeat and forbids a second independent tally, while the obs idiom (compute in the fields position at span open) forces timeline.execute's emission_count to be the DECLARED total, not the live-observed one. Resolved by making the split explicit — declared total on timeline.execute, observed per-batch on emit.batch — but the plan does not reconcile that split against the heartbeat, which this chunk does not modify.

The P4 implement console reported 20 migrated scenario TOMLs and three out-of-plan files; git status shows 23 and four. The undercount came from narrating counts from memory of the edit sequence rather than reading the diffstat — the operator caught both before the report was authored, and detectors read the Changes section as the sole source of what changed.

the report's Counts/qualifiers bullet enumerated which docs state the moved value and missed one: layout-templates.md:188-190 bakes the old whole-scenario caption literal (runs 900s over a 600s ceiling) that classify can no longer produce; the layouts detector found it anyway and flagged the report's inventory as incomplete, so the miss cost no coverage but the bullet was authored from a grep that searched for exemption-count and derivability wording rather than for the caption text
